title: The Contact form block takes a photo for the website Contact page hero, and website photos picked from the Loom render

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07 15:52: 'Use this for the contact page hero image.' LIVE-838 follow-up.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: the website Contact page hero (LIVE-838) reads the Contact form block's image, but the block had no photo field, so an owner could not set one; and the house theme read block photos only as plain URL strings, so a photo picked from the Loom (stored as an AssetRef, ADR-1245) vanished from the website. THE FIX: the contactForm schema gains an upload field 'Website Contact page photo' (key image), and components/sites/house-home.tsx reads every block photo through safeImageUrl.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/entity-blocks/block-content.ts','utf8');const h=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/house-home.tsx','utf8');if(!/label: 'Website Contact page photo'/.test(b)||/typeof b.image === 'string'/.test(h)){console.error('LIVE-839: the Contact form block has no photo field, or website photos still drop Loom picks');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (no field; string-only image reads); passes once this lands.
